notes: Zero-WDA Liquid Glass compositing so screenshots and video recordings always show the dock, pixel-exact Liquid Glass alignment under maximized browsers, and instant Windows taskbar suppression on physical Win-key presses.

releases.title: Screenshot & Video Visible Liquid Glass, Alignment Fix & Win-Key Taskbar Guard
changes: Upgraded Liquid Glass, iOS Glass, and Midnight backdrop compositing to a Zero-WDA behind-dock pipeline so the dock stays 100% visible in screenshots and video recordings (OBS, Snipping Tool, Win+Shift+S, Game Bar, Discord) unless Hide in screenshots is enabled.
Fixed Liquid Glass / iOS Glass / Midnight vertical alignment under maximized browsers by syncing live window position across resize and DPI changes and removing vertical capture overhang.
Added an instant WinEventHook taskbar guard and recovered backoff so pressing the physical Win key never leaves the native Windows taskbar visible.

releases.title: Auto-Hide Top-Edge Fix, Auto-Fitted Icon Scaling & Refined Hover Lift
changes: Fixed the top edge of the dock getting sliced off on startup when Auto-hide is enabled by sizing the WebView2 viewport with full DPI-scaled headroom from launch and unifying dock bounds synchronization.
Fixed App Icon Size above 100% (e.g. 130%) overlapping neighboring tile borders by automatically fitting icon sizes cleanly inside each dock tile.
Refined the dock app hover animation so only the app icon gently lifts over the dock border while the rounded tile card stays stationary.
Preserved existing Auto-hide and Windows Taskbar preferences across updates and restored silent one-click updater relaunch.

releases.title: Movable Dock Segments, Standalone Start Button, GPU Graph & Claude Max Usage
changes: Added movable Dock Segments (split the dock into 2, 3, or 4 floating Liquid Glass segments with custom gap, horizontal offsets, and drag or right-click widget assignment).
Detached the Start (N) button into a standalone movable widget that can be dragged anywhere on the dock and customized via right-click -> Change icon.
Added live GPU load, GPU temperature history graph, and GPU on Bar toggle in the Temperature widget.
Fixed Claude Max / Pro / Team plan detection, dynamic 7-day Fable/Opus/Sonnet buckets, and 0% session usage in Claude Usage widgets.
Added automatic Windows Taskbar pinned apps and exact order import, an optional dark-glass interactive Welcome Tutorial, and non-blocking async loading for All Widgets.

releases.title: Live Liquid Glass Notifications, Discord Avatars & Reply Bar
changes: Upgraded notification banners to use the real-time WebGL2 Liquid Glass refraction engine (with DXGI WDA_EXCLUDEFROMCAPTURE self-capture protection) so moving windows, games, and videos refract live underneath notifications.
Added circular sender profile pictures (PFP avatars) with mini corner app badges and an inline quick-reply bar on Discord notifications.

Added a Mute when app is visible on screen setting in Settings -> General -> Notifications for multi-monitor setups so banners are skipped when the app is already open and uncovered on another monitor.

releases.title: SteelSeries Nova & Keychron Link 2.4G Battery, Thermal Telemetry & Live Network Speed
changes: Added 2.4 GHz wireless battery detection for SteelSeries Arctis Nova 5 / 5P / 5X / 3P / 3X / 7 / 7P / 7X / 7+ / GameBuds / Nova Pro Wireless / Arctis 9 / Rival 3 Wireless and HyperX Cloud Alpha Wireless.
Added Keychron Link 2.4 GHz receiver and QMK wireless keyboard detection (K2 HE, K4/K6/K8/K10 HE, Q/V/K Max, K/Q/B Pro) plus Ultra-Link 8K wireless mice (M5, M6).

Upgraded Temperature telemetry to reject static motherboard ACPI placeholders (such as 17C on AMD AM5 boards) and read live CPU, GPU (WDDM D3DKMT, AMD ADL, NVIDIA NVML), and NVMe SSD SMART temperatures.
Fixed live Network Speed chart and throughput counters across all Ethernet, Wi-Fi, and Gigabit network adapters.

releases.title: Elevated Window Toggle, Ethernet NIC Detection & Auto-Hide Polish
changes: Fixed dockbar click-to-minimize and restore for elevated (Run as Administrator) apps and games including Task Manager.
Fixed Ethernet adapter detection across all IEEE 802.3 and Gigabit NIC drivers so wired connections never report No Ethernet port.
Fixed auto-hide dock clipping and edge hover stability when revealing the dock from the bottom or top screen edge.

releases.title: Wireless Device Battery Monitor, RAM Optimization & Shell Stability
changes: Added native Wireless Device Battery Monitor in Quick Toggles and as a standalone System widget supporting Logitech Lightspeed/Bolt/Unifying, Razer HyperSpeed, HyperX, SteelSeries, DualSense/DS4, Xbox Wireless, and Bluetooth devices.
Added automatic Ethernet detection and dedicated Ethernet Quick Toggle popover for desktops and wired laptops.
Reduced total RAM footprint by ~50% (down to ~150-180 MB) when opening Settings and Widget Center, with instant zero-shift scrolling across all 104 widgets.
Improved startup stability, screenshot visibility when Hide in screenshots is off, Task Manager dock activation, and instant taskbar recovery even if NexBar is force-closed from Task Manager.

releases.title: Real Liquid Glass, Adjustable FPS & Core Fixes
changes: Upgraded Liquid Glass to real-time DXGI Desktop Duplication so desktop icons, moving windows, videos, and animated wallpapers refract live underneath the dock.
Added a Liquid Glass refresh rate setting (Auto, 30 FPS, 60 FPS, Max) in Settings -> Appearance -> Glass & Opacity.
Fixed restoring minimized windows from the dock so previously maximized windows reopen maximized instead of shrinking.
Audio Output widget now updates immediately in real time when changing volume via keyboard keys, headsets, or Windows sound controls.

releases.title: Single-Device License Activation
changes: License keys now bind automatically to the first PC they are activated on, limiting each key to one device.
Re-activating your license on the same PC continues to work seamlessly, while full offline validation stays active after initial activation.

releases.title: Notification Text Size & Live License Delivery
changes: Added notification text size options (Small, Medium, Large, XL) in Settings and Notification Center, with larger default readability for WhatsApp and app messages.
Notification banners and inline reply boxes now resize cleanly to match your chosen text size.
Connected live license key generation after checkout so Pro keys are delivered immediately on purchase.

releases.title: Dock Stability, Bluetooth Discovery & Auto-Updates
changes: Fixed the dock briefly jumping upward when opening or closing apps.
All background apps now appear properly in the system tray, and double-clicking the tray icon closes the popup.
Added live device search in the Bluetooth menu to find nearby headphones, speakers, and accessories.
Fixed Storage free space display on first open and added automatic updates with the new Changelog tab.

releases.title: App Icon & License Checkout
changes: Updated the NexBar app icon with the new metallic N design.
Fixed the Buy button in Settings so it opens the license checkout page directly in your browser.
Improved taskbar restoration when closing or uninstalling NexBar.

releases.title: Liquid Glass & Smart Widgets
changes: Added Liquid Glass dock styling and smooth icon magnification.
Added Focus timer, Screen Time, Weather, Stocks, Calendar, and AI usage widgets.
